name: Mac Menu Bar & Menus

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: Top system menu strip (app name, File Edit View Help) seen in Codex reference screenshot
Existing AnchoredMenu, model picker, overflow menus
Right-side panels like the model list in user's screenshot

representativeVariants.whySelected: Desktop Electron top strip: translucent, 28px tall, spans the screen
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: bold app name; menu titles File/Edit/View/Help with open-state pill; right cluster: status icons, window controls

representativeVariants.whySelected: Native-feeling menu: compact rows, right-aligned shortcuts, checkmarks, submenu arrow
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: section header (11px uppercase muted); rows: 16px icon + label + flex spacer + shortcut kbd / check / caret; separators 1px hairline with 6px margins

representativeVariants.whySelected: Right-side rich popover (model list, settings) — menu chrome wrapping custom content
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: collapsible groups, selectable list rows with trailing check, status dots, footer action

representativeVariants.whySelected: Menu item hover is the classic macOS blue wash; in glass theme a primary-tinted translucent wash

traits.hover: background color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 18%, transparent); radius 6px

structurePatterns: Menu rows are 28px tall (24px compact), padded 10px horizontal, 6px radius wash
Shortcut text 12px in muted-foreground; check and caret share the trailing slot
Bar menus toggle a subtle glass pill on the open parent

usageHints.do: Right-align shortcuts; disable items rather than hiding; keep menus keyboard navigable
usageHints.avoid: No mega-menu cards inside NSMenu; rich content goes in inspector-popover

unknowns: Submenu flyout positioning handled by AnchoredMenu primitive
keyInsightSeed: Menus are the densest glass: small rows, exact 28px rhythm, one tinted wash for hover.
